name: grep
description: AST-based structural search for complete code-shaped syntax patterns, not text substring or regex search.

outputSchema.matches: array - matched code with file, line, and captures
outputSchema.totalMatches: number - total number of matches found
outputSchema.degraded: boolean - true when fallback mode is used

notes: Use $VAR for single captures and $$$VAR for zero-or-more captures
Use single quotes in PowerShell to avoid $ expansion
Bare identifiers match whole syntax nodes; fragments such as revok are not substring search
Regex literals, regex wildcards, and | alternation are not valid basic AST patterns
Use complete patterns such as app.delete($PATH, $HANDLER)
--file-pattern accepts a literal relative file or directory, not a wildcard glob
Use host text/content search for literal paths, fragments, comments, or regex
Use after context --format index jump-target selection
Follow matches with targeted file-range reads
Zero matches are an unresolved evidence gap unless appropriate semantics and adequate scope were verified
